goal: Maintain reproducible, knowledge-model-derived, normalized, live-proven staging compact plans for every runnable feature and the exact current master-validation inventory, targeting at least 80% fewer physical AKS births and a successful master-validation wall time of at most 60 minutes without weakening test semantics.
strategy: Derive compatibility, ordering, splits, terminal routes, and normalization findings from the knowledge model and checked-in specs; feature names and missing labels are not semantic boundaries.
Preserve verdict semantics, canonical create shape, starting state, operations, safeguard GETs, and cleanup ownership; shared tests must not create or delete their carrier.
Optimize physical AKS births and successful critical-path wall time, counting nested creates, recreates, and retries separately from logical planner groups.
Keep every execution carrier at or below 15 specs, and retain explicit reviewed reasons for zero-saving features and every non-sharing decision.
Prioritize normalization and planner repairs by safe physical births and critical-path minutes saved, then require exact-source staging ADO evidence before integration into origin/dev.

planning.focus: Make the full default feature portfolio and exact current master-validation selector truthful, bounded, executable compact plans; close the highest-value normalization and runtime blockers until live staging reaches the target or proves the safe Pareto frontier.
successCriteria: Every runnable feature has a complete default staging compact plan; any zero-saving feature has an exact reviewed semantic or readiness reason.
The exact checked-in master-validation selector is planned as one cross-feature portfolio before immutable, logical-history, readiness, and 15-spec policy boundaries are applied.
Both default and master plans save at least 80% of physical AKS births, with nested creates, recreates, and retries included in baseline and planned counts.
Every selected spec preserves starting state, operations, verdicts, safeguard reads, canonical create shape, and cleanup; shared tests neither create nor delete their carrier.
Every compatibility, order, split, terminal, and normalization decision cites the knowledge model, spec contract, or explicit execution policy, and unknowns remain visible normalization findings.

Deterministic repository checks and a no-new-model-errors ratchet protect compact-used planner and runner surfaces; every model object selected by either compact inventory validates even while unrelated historical debt remains visible.

Generated evidence records exact source, model, vocabulary, spec, target, and planner-contract fingerprints plus planned-versus-actual births and runtime; live execution rejects a missing or stale fingerprint with a regeneration command.
A successful exact-source staging master-validation ADO run completes in at most 60 minutes and every accepted journey has per-spec and cleanup proof integrated into origin/dev.

If the two numeric targets are infeasible, the delivered result is the measured safe Pareto optimum with the remaining product, quota, or semantic constraints explicit; tests are not weakened to claim success.
